kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتئس (form VIII)
# نَرْتَئِسُ (nartaʔisu) /nar.ta.ʔi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# نَرْتَئِسَ (nartaʔisa) /nar.ta.ʔi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# نَرْتَئِسْ (nartaʔis) /nar.ta.ʔis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
